name: Al-Maktaba al-Shamela — Shamela Library
notes: One of the largest free Arabic full-text book libraries (thousands of classical and modern books, page-based HTML full text). Live search WIRED in build_article.py (search_arab_libraries, tag library:shamela) via the site's own POST /ajax/search {term} endpoint, probed 2026-11-26: HTTP 200 with real srch-result book-page hits, and a returned book page (shamela.ws/book/14100/2886) opened with its full text (nass) readable — full text verified reachable under the full-text-only law. Transport from the sandbox is intermittent: responses are sometimes truncated (IncompleteRead) and the CDN sometimes closes the body stream to Python clients outright for stretches (HTTP 200, empty body) while curl succeeds; the searcher uses a TLS-1.2-capped context, salvages partial bodies and retries once, fail-soft. Especially valuable for PRIMARY sources (the author's own books).

name: Maktabat al-Mustafa al-Iliktruniyya — Al-Mustafa Electronic Library
notes: The prominent public 'Maktabat al-Mustafa' book library at al-mostafa.com (catalogue files hosted on al-mostafa.info; NOT the Al-Mustafa International University portal — the name is shared, this is the public e-book library Jupiter's naming matches). Registry-only for now: its search (POST search1.php, SearchRadio=all) answered live on 2026-11-26 and returned direct PDF links to primary works for the query 'Biruni' — Tahqiq ma li'l-Hind, al-Jamahir fi Ma'rifat al-Jawahir, al-Athar al-Baqiya and more — BUT the al-mostafa.info file server's HTTPS is broken from the build sandbox (empty reply / TLS wrong-signature-type across curl, urllib and wget, all TLS variants tried), so full-text delivery could not be verified; under the full-text-only law it stays registry-only until the PDF route verifies. The same works are reachable via the Internet Archive searcher.

name: Al-Maktaba al-Waqfeya — Waqfeya Library
notes: Large free Arabic waqf book library (thousands of scanned books). Registry-only for now: the current waqfeya.net is a Next.js client-side app — /search?q= and /books?q= return loading shells with no server-rendered results, the RSC data payload contains no results, and api.waqfeya.net closed the connection during the 2026-11-26 probe, so no machine-usable search route exists. Its book pages DO link full PDFs hosted on archive.org (the WAQ collection, e.g. identifier WAQkamilt), so Waqfeya books are reachable through the engine's Internet Archive searcher.

name: Noor Book — Maktabat Nur
notes: Large Arabic e-book library (120,000+ works claimed). Registry-only for now: every route probed on 2026-11-26 (home, /en/search, sitemap.xml, via curl and urllib) was stopped by a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge (HTTP 403) or a closed connection from the build sandbox, so neither search nor full text could be verified live.

name: Mu'assasat Hindawi — Hindawi Foundation
notes: Egyptian non-profit publishing free Arabic books (diamond OA, CC-licensed translations and originals). Registry-only for now: hindawi.org sits behind a Cloudflare challenge — home, /search and /books answered HTTP 403 'Just a moment' and the sitemap only redirects into the challenge during the 2026-11-26 probe (curl and urllib), so no search route or full text could be verified live from the sandbox.

name: Iraqi Journal of Science — University of Baghdad (Iraq alternate route)
notes: Iraq alternate route, WIRED in build_article.py (search_arab_libraries, tag iraq:ijs): the national IASJ platform itself closed every connection from the sandbox (site, OAI-PMH and alternate host all probed 2026-11-26), so Iraqi journal content is reached through this large University of Baghdad OJS journal directly. OJS search answered live with 20 real article summaries per query and a returned article's galley PDF was verified (%PDF-1.7, ~1.16 MB) — full text reachable under the full-text-only law. Its OAI-PMH endpoint (index.php/eijs/oai?verb=Identify) also answers HTTP 200.
